title: Custom Blanket Builder
description:
The Custom Blanket Builder helps you plan any blanket with the yarn, gauge, and machine you have. Enter your finished size, gauge, and preferred construction style, and the tool calculates needle counts, rows, shaping details (when needed), and a clear step-by-step plan you can follow at the machine.
It’s the fastest way to turn “I want to knit a blanket” into a project you feel confident starting.
excerpt: Design a custom blanket with your exact measurements and gauge.
metaTitle: Custom Blanket Builder | Knit it Now
metaDescription: Design any blanket for your machine. Check your width, adjust your gauge, and plan panels — all before you knit.
